evals.prompt: Restyle site/index.html in the paper and pencil storybook style, like statechart-art. Keep all the content.
evals.expected_output: The landing page uses the paper-pencil tokens, type and editorial layout; content, links and scripts are unchanged; the checker passes and the page was looked at at phone and desktop widths.

assertions.text: Every heading, paragraph, link href and script from the original page is still present
scripts/check_style.py reports 0 findings, or each remaining finding is listed with a reason
No saturated colour other than --red and --green appears in page CSS
The page does not load Kevin Serif or Kevin Sans
The report states that the page was rendered at about 390px and 1280px, or says that rendering was unavailable

evals.prompt: Add a hand-drawn coloured-pencil SVG plate to the page showing how a command goes from typed, to searched, to ranked, to shown, in that paper-and-pencil style.
evals.expected_output: An inline square SVG plate with every stage and step drawn as objects from one world, ink in two passes, pencil tints, labels on clean paper, arrows stopping short, and a caption with a red roman numeral.

assertions.text: All four stages and the three steps between them appear as labelled elements in the SVG
The plate references pp-ink, pp-ink-b and pp-pencil from a single shared defs block
Plate text is at least 32 units in a 1080 viewBox and no label overlaps a line or another object
The SVG has role=img with a title and a desc that lists the stages
Red appears only on elements whose meaning the caption or a legend states

evals.prompt: Does docs/index.html follow the paper-pencil style? Just tell me what is off, don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: A list of deviations from the invariants with file and line, using the checker plus a visual read, and no edits.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/check_style.py and reports its findings
Also reports invariants the checker cannot see, such as typography, layout order or captions

evals.prompt: Make our dashboard look modern with glassmorphism and gradient cards.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not activate; the request belongs to a general frontend design skill.

assertions.text: ui-paper-pencil-design is not selected for this request

evals.prompt: Generate a watercolour illustration PNG of a cat for my blog header.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not activate; raster image generation belongs to an image generation skill.

assertions.text: ui-paper-pencil-design is not selected for this request
